styles.name: Short and direct
styles.best_when: A good default for most leads.

styles.name: Before the layout is fixed
styles.best_when: A new campus, a new office or a big lease: the cafeteria and dish-wash area are probably still being planned.

styles.name: Forwardable to your caterer
styles.best_when: The company probably has a caterer: give the reader something they can forward to the caterer.

styles.name: Reusable instead of single-use
styles.best_when: The lead has a plastic, waste or sustainability angle in the evidence.

styles.name: Reply to a tender
styles.best_when: The trigger is a published tender or bid.

styles.name: Hostel, mess and canteen
styles.best_when: A college, hospital or hostel with a mess or canteen.

styles.name: For caterers (partnership)
styles.best_when: The lead is a caterer or food-service operator: pitch a partnership, not a purchase.

styles.name: For fit-out and design firms
styles.best_when: An interior or fit-out firm that can bring us into cafeteria projects.

styles.name: Ask for an introduction
styles.best_when: The contact is a gatekeeper (e.g. a registrar or an MD) or nobody relevant was found.

styles.name: Very short question
styles.best_when: A busy reader. Two sentences only.
